candidate.answerReason: The positive coefficient in y²=4x gives a parabola opening along the positive x-axis, so choice A is correct.

methods.label: Use the standard parabola form
methods.explanation: \(y^2\) equals a positive number times \(x\), so the focus lies on the positive x-axis and the parabola opens to the right.
methods.levelReason: Uses the standard high-school relation between the equation, focus position, and opening direction.

methods.label: Use nonnegative squares
methods.explanation: Rewrite the equation as \(x=y^2/4\). Thus \(x\ge0\), with equality only when \(y=0\), and opposite values of \(y\) give the same \(x\). The vertex is the origin, and as \(|y|\) increases, both branches extend farther in the positive \(x\)-direction. Therefore the parabola opens to the right, choice A.
methods.levelReason: Determines the opening directly from elementary properties of squares and coordinates, without using the focus formula.
